name: usage-metrics
description: A one-line band above the prompt (context fill, turn chart, rate limits with countdown and pace, cost, MCP servers), toasts when a limit is near, and a /usage-metrics pane with the breakdown, recent turns, tool results, cache share and a 30-day history; `/usage-metrics export` writes CSV.

segments.title: Band segments
segments.description: Which segments the band shows, in order, comma-separated: context, tokens, chart, delta, limits, cost, mcp.

warnAt.title: Warn at (%)
warnAt.description: First toast when the context or a rate-limit window reaches this percentage.

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Show a toast when a threshold is crossed.

cacheToast.title: Cache toast
cacheToast.description: Show a toast when the session's prompt-cache share of input falls below 50%.
